## <img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/QssGEmpkyEOhBCb7e1/giphy.gif?cid=ecf05e47a0n3gi1bfqntqmob8g9aid1oyj2wr3ds3mg700bl&rid=giphy.gif" width="25"> About Me

Backend and infrastructure engineer with a thing for automation, reliability, and making systems scale. Lately most of my time goes into infrastructure as code with Terraform and gluing environments together with shell scripts. When I'm not tinkering with pipelines, you'll find me gaming.

- 🏗️ **Building:** cloud infrastructure as code with Terraform, wired up with CI/CD pipelines
- 🐚 **Automating:** ops and developer workflows with Bash and shell scripting
- 📚 **Going deeper on:** Terraform module design, state management, and running workloads on Kubernetes
- 🤖 **Exploring:** backend systems that put AI to practical use
- ✍️ **Writing:** notes on what I break and fix, over on [Medium](https://medium.com/@boluwatufeadeojo)
- 🎮 **Off the clock:** gaming
